description:
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.


At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.


Role overview


We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.


In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.


You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.


Responsibilities


Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices


Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles


Tool Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and AI assistant tools, including users, permissions and security settings
  • Track licences and flag unused or underused accounts
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of tools, accounts and admin roles


Automation

  • Automate onboarding so new joiners get the right access on day one
  • Automate offboarding so leavers lose access promptly and their data is handled correctly
  • Build integrations and workflows between tools using automation platforms or scripting


Security Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor security alerts, sign-in activity and admin logs, and act on issues
  • Work with our security and DevOps colleagues on infrastructure hardening
  • Handle first-line access requests and support tickets from colleagues
  • Investigate incidents, then record causes and fixes


Documentation

  • Document every tool, automation and process so others can understand and run it
  • Write clear guides for colleagues on access and security practices
  • Share regular progress updates and agree priorities with your manager

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering tools for organisations of 50+ people
  • Hands-on experience administering Okta (or equivalent IAM solution) and Google Workspace
  • A track record of driving IT or security initiatives, not only handling tickets
  • Willingness to handle requests from the team, helping keep tools and infrastructure running smoothly


Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of identity and access management, including SSO, MFA and role-based access
  • Working knowledge of device management and endpoint protection
  • Ability to build workflows with automation platforms, APIs or scripting
  • Understanding of security good practice for SaaS tools and BYOD environments
  • Cybersecurity experience is a strong plus
  • An engineering degree is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher


Soft Skills

  • Takes ownership and works independently in a less structured environment
  • Coachable and open to feedback
  • Explains technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Organised, prioritises well and follows through
  • Collaborative and low-ego team player


What we offer


  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid Vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff.
